projects.name: MAKgadgets
projects.description: Full-featured electronics e-commerce platform with admin tools for products, inventory, orders, and promotions.
projects.overview: MAKgadgets is a full-featured electronics e-commerce platform built to manage products, orders, inventory, customers, and promotional content from a centralized admin panel. The project focuses on creating a smooth shopping experience for customers while giving the internal team practical tools for catalog management, bulk product updates, order processing, and day-to-day store operations.
features: Centralized admin panel for catalog and operations
Bulk product updates and media handling
Pricing, stock tracking, and category organization
projects.challenges: Built a system that could handle a large, frequently changing product catalog without slowing admin work—simplifying uploads, image management, pricing, stock tracking, and categories while keeping the storefront fast and reliable.

projects.name: MIKHAIL HOLDINGS LTD
projects.description: Corporate website for a diversified development company across real estate, manufacturing, R&D, and retail.
projects.overview: Mikhail Holdings is a diversified development company focused on creating opportunities across commercial, residential, and industrial sectors. With a business structure spanning real estate, manufacturing, research and development, and retail/consumer development, the website serves as a central platform for communicating the company’s diverse capabilities, vision, and areas of expertise.
features: Multi-division company presentation in one cohesive site
projects.challenges: Presented diverse business divisions within one clear digital experience—keeping real estate, manufacturing, R&D, and retail content structured, professional, and easy to navigate.

projects.name: OnlineWill Write Power of Attorney Forms
projects.description: UK-focused online will-writing platform that makes creating a will simple, trustworthy, and accessible.
projects.overview: Online Will Write is a UK-focused online will-writing service designed to make creating a will more accessible, convenient, and straightforward. The platform provides users with a simple digital experience for getting started with their will, helping remove the complexity often associated with traditional will-writing services.
features: Power of attorney related form flows
projects.challenges: Made a complicated legal process feel simple and trustworthy online—clear value messaging, confident step-by-step guidance, and reduced friction while keeping a professional UX.

projects.name: Mobile Lube, LLC
projects.description: Service website for a mobile oil-change business that brings vehicle maintenance to the customer.
projects.overview: Mobile Lube is a convenient mobile oil change service designed to bring professional vehicle maintenance directly to customers. The website communicates the convenience of getting an oil change without visiting a traditional service center, helping customers save time while keeping their vehicles properly maintained.
features: Clear service value proposition and CTA flow
MySQL content and service data structure
projects.challenges: Communicated convenience and trust quickly—simplifying the customer journey so visitors understand the offer and take action without information overload.

projects.name: Francesca
projects.description: Laravel + React platform with real-time messaging and notification features for interactive client workflows.
projects.overview: Francesca is a client web application built with Laravel, React, MySQL, and Inertia. The product focuses on interactive communication through real-time messaging and real-time notifications, giving users a responsive experience for collaboration and updates inside the platform.
projects.challenges: Delivered reliable real-time messaging and notifications on top of a Laravel/Inertia stack while keeping UI interactions responsive and stable for client users.

projects.name: Dio Dio Glow
projects.description: Beauty and skincare discovery platform with TikTok RapidAPI feeds, product catalog, multilingual UI, and AWS S3 media.
projects.overview: DiodioGlow is a beauty and skincare discovery platform designed to help users explore trending beauty content, TikTok videos, skincare products, and related resources through a centralized digital experience. The application combines social-media-driven content with product discovery and multilingual functionality. A key technical feature is RapidAPI integration for fetching TikTok video information in real time, plus AWS S3 for scalable image and media storage.
features: Real-time TikTok video fetching via RapidAPI
Dynamic TikTok feed with creator, caption, and engagement data
Beauty and skincare product catalog with categories/filters
AWS S3 cloud storage for media assets
Google Analytics and Search Console integration
projects.challenges: Integrated RapidAPI TikTok data and AWS S3 media at scale—handling API errors/rate limits, normalizing dynamic responses, securing credentials, optimizing media-heavy performance, and keeping multilingual content consistent.

projects.name: Simonjeger
projects.description: Personal academic site for an EPFL robotics researcher showcasing research, projects, and publications.
projects.overview: Simon Jeger is a robotics researcher and doctoral assistant at EPFL’s Laboratory of Intelligent Systems, working at the intersection of robotics, autonomous systems, and aerial vehicles. His personal website provides a focused digital space to present his research, projects, publications, and work in intelligent aerial robotics.
projects.challenges: Presented complex robotics research clearly—balancing scientific depth with a simple, professional site that makes projects and publications easy to explore.

projects.name: Inventory & Stock Management
projects.description: Role-based inventory workflow with product, stock, supplier, and reporting modules.
projects.overview: A practical inventory system built for day-to-day stock control. Admins and staff can manage products, track stock movement, handle suppliers, and generate useful reports without messy spreadsheets.
features: Role-based access for admin and staff users
Product create, update, and category management
Stock in / stock out tracking with history
projects.challenges: Kept stock updates consistent across modules and made role permissions clear so staff only see what they need.

projects.name: Payment Gateway Integration
projects.description: Secure checkout integration with transaction handling, validation, and admin visibility.
projects.overview: Backend payment flow that connects checkout requests to a payment gateway, validates responses, stores transaction status, and gives admins a clear view of successful and failed payments.
features: Secure checkout request and callback handling
REST API endpoints for frontend checkout
projects.challenges: Focused on reliable callback handling and clear transaction states so money movement stays auditable.

projects.name: Responsive Business Website
projects.description: Mobile-first website with clean sections, reusable UI blocks, and browser-compatible styling.
projects.overview: A responsive business website designed mobile-first. Clean section layout, reusable UI pieces, and consistent styling across modern browsers.
projects.challenges: Balanced visual polish with simple reusable components so the site stays fast and easy to extend.
